policies.name: owner_export_jobs_application_insert
policies.withCheck:
((job_type = 'portability.owner-export-assembly.v1'::text) AND (payload_version = 1) AND (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'::text) AND ( SELECT ((count(*))::integer = 4)
   FROM jsonb_object_keys(jobs.payload) jsonb_object_keys(jsonb_object_keys)) AND (payload ?& ARRAY['exportId'::text, 'portfolioId'::text, 'ownerId'::text, 'includedScopes'::text]) AND ((payload ->> 'portfolioId'::text) = NULLIF(current_setting('shipwithali.portfolio_id'::text, true), ''::text)) AND ((payload ->> 'ownerId'::text) = NULLIF(current_setting('shipwithali.owner_id'::text, true), ''::text)) AND ((payload ->> 'exportId'::text) ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-7[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((payload -> 'includedScopes'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND ((jsonb_array_length((payload -> 'includedScopes'::text)) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length((payload -> 'includedScopes'::text)) <= 7)) AND (jsonb_array_length((payload -> 'includedScopes'::text)) = ( SELECT count(DISTINCT elements.value_text) AS count
   FROM jsonb_array_elements_text((jobs.payload -> 'includedScopes'::text)) elements(value_text))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM jsonb_array_elements_text((jobs.payload -> 'includedScopes'::text)) members(value_text)
  WHERE (members.value_text <> ALL (ARRAY['portfolio-content'::text, 'taxonomy'::text, 'media-metadata'::text, 'cv-metadata'::text, 'moderation-history'::text, 'analytics-reports'::text, 'portfolio-configuration'::text]))))))
